_: Promenade, from the modded census of 26.1.2 (W4 R12, judged 2026-11-13), as 26.2's, 26.3's, 1.20.1's and 1.16.5's promenade.json have it. Named one by one, only the blocks that census saw as ground and judged, because any word a rule could read would take other mods' blocks with it, and because a file reaches a config that already holds detection's line where a changed rule does not. Blunite's polished forms, slabs, stairs and walls were not judged and are left to the rules, asphalt was excluded as made, and the dark amaranth wart block was excluded as growth.

Stone: blunite is solid natural rock the mod lays in the overworld's ground, which the rules leave out for having no stone word. Nether: dark amaranth nylium is a nylium, the living top over netherrack, the Nether's own ground by what it is, on a rock material the rules leave out for having no stone word; it was judged first by this census, and 26.2's and 26.3's rule it the same (W4 R13, 2026-11-13), so the editions match.

A slab or stair takes its full block's ruling (Xep, 2026-11-13: Can we make it so all slabs of blocks that wear, also wear, in their own like the full blocks do? and: Same with stairs as slabs; W4 R15). These are this mod's slabs and stairs whose full blocks a census of 26.1.2 judged, each named at its full block's family so it wears on its own texture as the full block does. A slab or stair of a block the census excluded, or never judged, is left as it was. Where an earlier note here leaves this mod's slabs and stairs to the rules, or to detection's family, the ones named below no longer are.
